title: 1st rate tour with local knowledge and passion.
text: Perfect way to experience the Basilica Familia.  Tour guide Elisabet was incredible. Contacted me days in advance to provide hotel pickup time. She provided a guided tour with professional knowledge and local passion.  Very patient given we aren't the fastest walkers.
author: David_M

title: Must see but skip the line
text: Skip the line very helpful. Lots of large tour groups at the site. Spectacular building! On a sunny day it glows.
author: Wendy_B

title: Fantastic tour with passionate guide
text: Mercedes was a fantastic guide.  She was so passionate about Gaudi and explained about everything really well.  Her communication before hand was great too.  We had a fantastic tour with her.  I would definately recommend it.
author: Christine_K

title: A pleasurable and knowledgeable guide through Sagrada Familia
text: I love that Anna was not only knowledgeable about the Sagrada Familia, but had great anecdotes and stories about the amazing church. She is funny and patient and definitely would recommend her to friends and family.
author: Thomas_D

title: Private tour of La Sagrada de familia
text:
Elisabet was a wonderful private guide for our multi generational family. Very knowledgeable. Has alot of energy and weaves stories into the history of La Sagrada de Familia. Went up in the tower with us and walked down spiral staircase. Lovely personality.  Highly recommended.
The Anderson/Elko Party of 8
author: KennethDenise_A

title: A tour not to be missed during a Barcelona visit.
text:
Elisabet was amazing and really understood the philosophy of Gaudi to explain the Sagrada Familia.
She explained all the main parts of the Cathedral. The afternoon visit highlighted the main features of light that pours into the orange stained glasses.
author: Mehul_T

title: The genius of Antoni Guadi
text: We were hesitant to book this tour but we are thrilled that we did! Our tour guide Elizabeth was extremely knowledgeable and passionate when sharing her knowledge with us. We feel like we had both a history lesson and a peak into the genius of the architect, Antoni Guadi.
author: Elisa_B

title: 100% would book again
text: Elisabet is extremely knowledgeable and we had a wonderful tour with her! The "skip the line" tickets with Elisabet was well worth it... Even more, she allowed us to choose what to spend time exploring.
author: Michal_P

title: Familia Sagrata, Barcelona
text: Great, very knowedgable guide.  Met us early and pointed out mang things about the history, future plans, as well as work now underway
author: John_S

title: A Great Guide for a Special Place
text: Elisabet made our visit to Sagrada Familia extra special.  Her knowledge of the building was extensive and we left with a wonderful understanding of the church.  She gave us time to take it all in while making sure we saw everything.   What a great guide for a special place.
author: Kag123456789
